project.name: BlockVars
project.description:
This plugin library offers vars useful when working with Protocols. Examples are: – VarDimension: allows to specify an integer dimension.
– VarPoint: allows to specify an integer point. – VarRectangle: allows to specify a rectangle with integer coordinates and dimensions.
Also, different blocks have been made available to use this variables: – Define Point – Define Dimension – Define Rectangle (by point and dimension) – Define Rectangle 2 (by 4 integer properties)
